paite: Huchi in Jerusalem mite'n atapa naupangpen Ahaziah asik in kumpipa ding in abawl ua; ata upate tengteng, Arab sepaihhonte, apanmun ua hong pai mite'n athat khin vek uhi. Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah in vai ahawmta hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah / (2 Kum 8.25-29; 9.21-28)

paite: Ahaziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmli-le-nih a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm a, anu min Athaliah, Omri tanu ahi.
Ama'n leng Ahab inkote lampi tot atawn a; anu bel thil giloutak a thuhilhtu ahi.
Ahab inkote hih bang mah in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a, apa sih nung in asiatna ding a thuhilhtu ahi.
Amah leng athuhilh un a-om a, Ramoth-gilead ah Siria kumpipa Hazael dou ding in Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Jehoram kiang ah ahoh a, huchi in Siriate'n Jehoram asuliam uhi.

Siria kumpipa Hazael asualna a Ramah a asukliam uh hihdam ding in Jezreel ah ahoh hi. Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Azariah bel Ahab tapa Jehoram adam louh ziak in aveh ding in Jezreel ah akuan hi.
Huchi in Jehoram kiang ah Ahaziah ahoh a, amanthatna Pathian hih ahi; Nimshi tapa Jehu sual ding in Jehoram kiang a ahoh ziak in. Huai mi bel Ahab inkote hihmang ding a TOUPA seh ahi him hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahab inkote hihse ding a asual lai in Judahte intekte leh Ahaziah nasem a-unau tapate amu a, athat vek hi.

Ahaziah azong ua, Samaria a akibuk lai in aman ua, Jehu kiang ah ahon pi ua, athat ua; alungtang tengteng a TOUPA Zong sek Jehoshaphat tapa ahi, achi ua, avui in avuithoh uhi. Huchi in Ahaziah inkote'n agam uah thuneihna aneita kei uhi.
Huan Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa si chih azak in athou a, Judah inkote kumpipa tengteng athat vek hi.
heading: Judah Kumpinu Athaliah / (2 Kum 11.1-3)

paite: Ahaziah tapa Joash bel kumpipa tanu Jehosabeath in kumpipa tapa athahte uh lak a kipan aselmang a, naudonmi toh lupna dantan sung ah asel hi. Huchi in kumpipa Jehoram tanu Jehosabeath, siampu Jehoiada zi in, (amah Ahaziah sanggamnu ahi a) Athaliah muh louh ding in aselgu a, huchi in athah in a-om kei hi.
Akiang ua teng in Pathian inn ah kum guk aguk in akibu a; huchi in Athaliah in agam uah vai ahawm hi.
